title: Photo 64

models.transformer: Transformer from the paper (arXiv:2611.31989): spike and gaze tokens to the full scene; five folds split by photograph, each scene decoded by the fold that held it out
models.diffusion: Diffusion model from the paper, conditioned on the same tokens; one fixed-seed render
models.display: raw model output clipped to [0, 1]; no calibration to the photograph

timeline: one step per 200 ms of usable viewing: in each presentation (chronological), the usable 100-ms windows taken every 200 ms; gaze at the window start; receptive-field tiles at their session offsets from gaze

paperProgress.source: the paper's transformer and diffusion model re-run on the first n presentations of this scene, in the chronological order of the replay; each checkpoint is exact at the end of its last presentation and the panels cross-fade between checkpoints; the last checkpoint is the paper's final render

fidelity.range: displayed 0-1 intensity, grey (channel mean), predictions clipped

transformer.source: exact checkpoints scored on the display domain; the chart interpolates between them

diffusion.source: exact checkpoints scored on the display domain; the chart interpolates between them
